metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the March slip, the fog, thirty-four shillings, and the sheet stopped after the dagger.

yesterday: The share is thirty-four shillings, counted by candle.
Next week you open Errors on Monday, you are in the Two Gentlemen on Tuesday, and you are Gaunt again on Wednesday.
The couplet is on the sheet. The dagger is in its sheath.
One candle. You wrote as far as the dagger.
He gets it wrong by a minute. That is the last thing you said.
